name: New Zealand Geographical Society
story: Founded in Wellington in 1944, the New Zealand Geographical Society formed from the Canterbury and Wellington geographical associations. It promotes the study of geography in Aotearoa and communicates geographical research locally, nationally and internationally. Its network spans schools, universities, research institutes, and public and private organisations; it supports geography teaching at secondary and tertiary levels and houses the Board of Geography Teachers.
